# Investorer, I har 780 mia. kr. tilovers og går glip af 10.000 kr. om måneden

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Euroinvestor Millionærklubben episode (20 Oct 2026) is mostly about Danish retail investing. Finans Danmark says about DKK 780bn of surplus savings sits idle in bank accounts, record money is flowing into retail funds, and it wants a higher, broader cap on the aktiesparekonto (share savings account) and a simpler capital tax system. Market commentary from chief analyst Lars Svendsen is mixed: he is cautious on Maersk and container shipping over the next year, but positive on Lundbeck after Lars Fruergaard's appointment as chairman, on Zealand Pharma (which he calls badly mistreated and trading near its cash value) and on Embla Medical as a long-term holding.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Svendsen holds many; trades at roughly cash value (~16bn market cap); sees the old ~900 top as reachable again; takeover possible.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen thinks the market undervalues Zealand: you pay about what it holds in cash. It has a GLP-2 drug for short bowel syndrome (approved in the EU, US pending) and obesity assets with Boehringer. He would add if it gets cheaper and thinks it could be taken over. Weak points: few projects and cash burn.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the GLP-2 drug fails US approval
- if the obesity phase 3 data disappoint further
- if cash burn erodes the cash cushion

> *"Jo, jo, jeg mener, at C-Land er blevet mishandlet, og man underkender virksomhedens evner."*

---

### 🟢 HLUN-B — H. Lundbeck | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Fruergaard as chairman seen as a positive move; share ~48, first-step target 60-65; Svendsen holds B shares.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen welcomes Lars Fruergaard as chairman: he ran Novo well and understands the chairman's role, i.e. not acting as a super-CEO. Along with the new CEO and foundation changes, Svendsen sees progress. Price is just under 48 against his first target of 60-65.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Fruergaard oversteps into a super-CEO role
- if governance conflicts with the Lundbeck Foundation emerge

> *"Den er i knap 48. Og mit mål har været, første trin, det er 60-65."*

---

### 🟢 EMBLA — Embla Medical | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Prosthetics maker; Svendsen calls it a long-term buy despite no gains yet.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen sees this steady, long-term prosthetics business as a long-term buy. He had not yet read the day's earnings report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the earnings report shows deteriorating growth

> *"I min verden er det jo et langsigtet køb."*

---

### 🟠 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Around 24,000; Svendsen expects a setback within a year and would rebuy at 15-17k; he has remaining shares he wants to sell near 30k.

#### Reasoning

Freight rates and volumes are good now. Within about a year, Svendsen expects a bump in the road: Suez/Red Sea routes reopening, trade tensions with China and no broad economic upswing. He disagrees with others' 30,000 target and prefers to wait for a pullback to buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the economic upswing materialises and freight stays strong
- if the price falls to 15-17k (buy trigger)

> *"jeg tror, der kommer et setback, og så kan vi jo måske komme til at købe AP Møller på 15-17 igen."*

---
